newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle moderate at $116/dressed-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle moderate at $116/dressed-USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were mostly $1.00 per cwt higher on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said. Trade was moderate.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1350 lbs 116.00. Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 116.00, few early 115.00.

Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 higher on a live basis. Buyer inquiry and demand good, but buyers rather selective in their buying and/or bidding. Seller interest mixed. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1250 lbs 72.50-73.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 73.00.
